title: Registry of Endocrine Tumors (Thyroid, Parathyroid, Adrenal, Endocrine Pancreas, Endocrine Digestive Tube)
summary: This registry aims to collect informations about patients with endocrine tumors (Thyroid, Parathyroid, Adrenal, Endocrine Pancreas, Endocrine Digestive Tube) who undergo endocrine surgical procedures. This registry is part of the Eurocrine Project.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients who undergo surgical procedures for endocrine tumors at the University Nancy Brabois Hospital

Exclusion Criteria:

* unable to receive clear information
* refusal to sign the consent form
